translations.gui.label.head: HEAD
translations.gui.btn.restore.tooltip: Restores the original tattoo composition if a merged skin MOD is active. Use this when you wish to re-edit or re-merge. Please note the memory consumption.
translations.gui.btn.merge.tooltip: Performs the merge process and allows you to preview the result. It will not be saved.
translations.gui.btn.revert.tooltip: Reverts to the state before the merge process was performed.
translations.gui.btn.save.tooltip: Saves the merged result as a MOD. When generating a new MOD, it will automatically handle the MOD update via MaidLoader if installed.
translations.gui.btn.replace.tooltip: Instantly replaces the current skin with the saved MOD. All items used in the merge will be unequipped.
translations.dlg.msg.overwrite_last: Will overwrite with the same name as the last save.
translations.dlg.msg.overwrite_exists: Will overwrite because the save destination already exists.
translations.dlg.msg.exists_same_name: Cannot save because there is a MOD with the same name in a different location.
translations.dlg.msg.failed_load_source: Failed to load the texture for merging.
translations.dlg.msg.save_confirmation: Save this merge result with the name below.
translations.dlg.msg.saved_available: Saved the merge result to MOD. Since it was an overwrite, it can be equipped/swapped immediately.
translations.dlg.msg.saved_auto_refresh: Saved the merge result to MOD and started MOD update with MaidLoader. Please wait until it becomes available.
translations.dlg.msg.saved_manual_refresh: Saved the merge result to MOD. You need to manually update the MOD list with MaidLoader or ModRefresh before it becomes available.
translations.dlg.msg.restore_confirmation: The current configuration conflicts with the restore data below. This process will overwrite the conflicting elements with the restore data. Are you sure?
translations.dlg.msg.double_merge: You are attempting to merge into an already merged MOD. Overwriting this will make it impossible to restore the original configuration. Please proceed with caution.
translations.cfg.language.desc: Language for the interface and messages (Changing this setting requires a game restart).
translations.cfg.language.changed: The language change to the configuration GUI will take effect after a game restart.
translations.cfg.target_category.desc: Operation target to filter category for merge sources.
translations.cfg.del_nipple_menu.desc: If a nipple deletion MOD exists, select it here or generate a deletion MOD. Otherwise, please do not merge the 'Nipple' item.
translations.cfg.del_nipple_menu.unavailable: Can only be changed in the Edit scene.
translations.cfg.del_nipple_menu.confirmation: Will generate deletion MOD for nipple. Are you sure?
translations.cfg.del_nipple_menu.generate_new:
Delete Nipple
 * Generate new by this plugin
translations.cfg.del_nipple_menu.generated_auto: Generated MOD and started MOD list update with MaidLoader. Please wait a moment.
translations.cfg.del_nipple_menu.generated_manual: Generated MOD. You need to manually update the MOD list with MaidLoader or ModRefresh.
translations.cfg.menu_priority.desc: Priority for menu order. Can be changed manually when saving.
translations.cfg.maid_name_style.desc: Maid fullname style for folder/file name. Can be changed manually when saving.
translations.cfg.name_prefix.desc: Prefix for save folder/file name. Can be changed manually when saving.
translations.cfg.main_resolution.desc: Max resolution for reducing size of MainTex/ShadowTex. 0 means as-is.
translations.cfg.outline_resolution.desc: Max resolution for reducing size of OutlineTex. 0 means as-is.
translations.cfg.auto_refresh.desc: Automatically refresh MaidLoader after saving generated MOD. If you have MaidLoader installed, the MaidLoader mod list will be refreshed to include the new MOD.
translations.cfg.language_for_pre_bind.desc: Language for configuration GUI. (The content of the configuration GUI is determined before the `language` setting value is read.) Changing the `language` setting on the GUI will automatically update this setting.
